sources.verified: Original CTR-001 notification light, green 3D indicator, wireless indicator, outer-camera activity light, two strap attachment openings, and full-size SD card slot. Published closed envelope remains 134 x 74 x 21 mm.
sources.local_dimensions: Indicator diameters, lens positions, strap tunnel dimensions and socket position were fitted to the official diagrams and are not published tolerances.

sources.verified: Full-size SD form factor is 32 x 24 x 2.1 mm.
sources.local_dimensions: The keyed corner, lock-slider notch, internal socket, and spring-contact shapes remain reconstructed approximations.

changes.basis: Previously absent parts identified by Nintendo; lenses are cut from existing external skins to retain the envelope.
Reclassify the 3D glyph as the documented green indicator; retain OFF as printed text.
Add two connected rear-to-side strap passages with retained molded anchors. Local geometry estimated.
Correct standard full-size SD envelope and align the socket contacts with the side-entry orientation.

limitations: No physical CTR-001 specimen was measured.
No factory mold, PCB or connector mechanical drawings were available.

The SD envelope is a standards-based correction; the reader is not a manufacturer-exact connector model. Its carrier and cage were enlarged, with reconstructed frame/shield seats and a local shield relief below the existing schematic NAND package.
Validation results belong in the output reports after the iteration is executed; this evidence file does not claim that execution passed.
